citytour: Explore Cartagena's historic landmarks with local guidance.
acuario: Discover Caribbean marine life in the Rosario Islands.
pasadia: Rosario Islands Day Trip — Sunny Day
A day trip to the Rosario Islands. Confirm the selected plan and inclusions before booking.
isla_palma: Isla Palma Nature Reserve Day Trip
Visit Hotel Isla Palma, with a panoramic boat journey through the Rosario and San Bernardo islands, gourmet lunch, beach access and a hotel-to-pier transfer. Port fees and insurance are additional.
corona_island: An adults-only experience for guests aged 18 and over, with a speedboat transfer, a three-course lunch, unlimited Corona beer, kayaking and paddleboarding.
tritonia: Tritonia Beach Club — Adults-only Day Trip
An adults-only beach club in Tintipán, reached by hotel pickup, bus and boat via Tolú. Includes a snack and return transport to Cartagena. The published plan welcomes pets.
mucura_tintipan: Múcura, Tintipán and Santa Cruz del Islote
Explore Tintipán, Casa en el Agua, Santa Cruz del Islote and Múcura with lunch. Port fees and insurance are not included.
isla_lizamar: Isla Lizamar — Pools and Beach Day
Enjoy Isla Grande, swimming pools, a slide into the sea, buffet lunch, a bilingual guide and a panoramic Rosario Islands boat trip. Optional services cost extra.
atardecer: Enjoy the sunset from Cartagena Bay. Confirm the vessel and selected plan with our team.
buceo: Explore Caribbean coral reefs with a guided diving experience and island lunch. Confirm the number of dives, experience requirements and return time for your selected plan.
kitesurf: Explore water sports in La Boquilla. Choose a specific lesson or rental package to confirm the final price.
paracaidismo: A tandem jump from 10,000 feet with a certified instructor and Caribbean Sea views. Photos and video are included in the published package.
citybahia: City Bahía by ROA — Lunch and Sunset
Visit Cartagena landmarks, enjoy lunch and finish with a speedboat sunset trip and two hours of selected drinks. A separate Full option includes the castle.
yate: Cartagena Bay Yacht Tour — Luna Mía
Cruise the bay with selected drinks, an onboard DJ, host and bartender. Departures are from Muelle de los Pegasos; confirm the time before booking.
yate_noche: Enjoy an onboard DJ, selected drinks and Cartagena's illuminated skyline. Published evening slots are 7–9 pm and 9–11 pm, subject to confirmation.
catamaran_noche: Music, cocktails, dancing and Cartagena's illuminated skyline. Choose a Silver or Gold package and confirm the evening departure.
chiva: Chiva Party Bus and Taboo Nightclub
A colorful evening tour past the Old Shoes monument, San Felipe Castle and Cartagena sign, with music, a bilingual host and entry to Taboo nightclub.
playablanca: A beach day with land transport, a welcome cocktail, a choice of lunch, pool access and sunbeds by the Caribbean.
medalloislas: Combine Puerto Medallo with a panoramic island trip, a wildlife excursion and snorkeling. Transport, lunch and pool access are included.
cabalgata: Beach Horseback Riding in La Boquilla
A one-hour horseback ride along La Boquilla beach. Published operating hours are 8 am to 5 pm; confirm your preferred time.
poloaviario: Polo Beach and the National Aviary
Combine Playa Tranquila and the National Aviary in Barú, with air-conditioned bus transport, a guide and lunch. Separate Colombian-resident and international-visitor rates apply.
polobeach: A day at Polo Beach with air-conditioned bus transport, a guide and a choice of lunch.
bqcartagena: Explore landmarks in both cities in one day, with lunch in Barranquilla, dinner in Cartagena, air-conditioned transport and a guide.
bqsantamarta: Barranquilla and Santa Marta City Tour
Visit landmarks in Barranquilla and Santa Marta with beach and pool time, breakfast and lunch. Confirm the departure for your chosen date.
citytour_roa: ROA Historic City Tour with Lunch

Stops: Castillo Grande Bay, Palenquera Monument, Rafael Núñez House, Cartagena letters, La Popa, Old Shoes Monument, San Felipe Castle, Pastelillo Fort and a Getsemaní walk. Lunch or dinner included; admissions depend on your plan.
catamaran: Watch the sunset from the sea with selected unlimited drinks and a live DJ. A separate Gold package is also offered.
atv: Cartagena ATV Tour — Beach and Trails
A 2.5-hour ATV adventure through beaches, hills and trails north of Cartagena. Lunch, a drink and transport are included.
tirolesa: A two-hour experience with five ziplines above the trees and Caribbean views. Lunch and transport are included.
tamarindo: A Tierra Bomba beach club with a pool, lounge bed, welcome cocktail, lunch and a semi-private beach. Transport is included.
namaste: Yoga, meditation, a massage, pool access, a detox juice and a consumption credit. Published rates are non-refundable; confirm all conditions before booking.
luxury_3: Visit three private islands in one day, with a speedboat, gourmet lunch, cocktails and hotel transfers.
islas_oceanario: Sail from Cartagena to the San Martín de Pajarales Oceanarium and enjoy a day in the Rosario Islands.
volcan_totumo: Experience the Totumo mud volcano on a guided excursion from Cartagena.
mambo_tierra: A Playa Blanca day trip with air-conditioned transport, sun loungers and a lunch credit at Mambo Beach Club.
mambo_lancha: Travel from Cartagena to Playa Blanca by boat and enjoy Mambo Beach Club facilities with lunch.
tour_magico_tierra: Magic Tour by Land — Beach, Snorkeling and Mangroves
Combine Playa Blanca, a mangrove excursion and snorkeling with land transport from Cartagena.
tour_magico_lancha: Magic Tour by Boat — Beach, Snorkeling and Mangroves
Travel by speedboat, go snorkeling, explore the mangroves and relax at Mambo Beach Club.
family_eco_route: A full day in Barú with Mambo Beach, snorkeling, mangroves, sunset and a bioluminescent-plankton experience.
golden_hours: Golden Hours — Sunset and Beach Club
A speedboat sunset outing with music, cocktails and a stop at a private beach club near Cartagena.
kitesurf_iniciacion: Learn the basics of kitesurfing in La Boquilla with a certified instructor.
kitesurf_refuerzo: A refresher lesson tailored to your existing skills.
kitesurf_grupal: Learn together in a group lesson.
kitesurf_downwind: A downwind kitesurf expedition; confirm skill and weather requirements.
kitesurf_alquiler_equipo: Rent a complete kitesurf equipment set.
kitesurf_supervision: Beach supervision while you use your own equipment.
